man-streetlife-blackpool.name: Streetlife Night Shelter
man-streetlife-blackpool.sign: 8 bedrooms, emergency overnight accommodation 365 days a year, ages 16-25

man-springofhope-bristol.name: Spring of Hope Women's Night Shelter
man-springofhope-bristol.sign: emergency night shelter for women 365 nights a year; by referral agencies

osm-way-327576971.name: Aidan House
osm-way-327576971.sign: Framework job advert (Aug 2026) and Framework post about Aidan House support hub (2026); 15 beds for women, referral only

hl-signposts-start-over-shelter.name: Signposts – Start Over Shelter (SOS)
hl-signposts-start-over-shelter.sign: Signposts site (© 2026): "Emergency accommodation in Luton ... Start Over Shelter 80-94 Guildford Hall"; services page: "21 direct access beds ... Staffed both day and night". Homeless Link: "Please Call 01582 825303 for DIRECT ACCESS. Or just turn up"
hl-signposts-start-over-shelter.access: Direct access: phone 01582 825303 or turn up (age 21+); no referral needed

hl-kings-lynn-night-shelter.name: King's Lynn Night Shelter
hl-kings-lynn-night-shelter.sign: Local Free News 13 Oct 2026: "King's Lynn Night Shelter has reopened after a break over summer ... based at St John's House in Blackfriars Road"
hl-kings-lynn-night-shelter.access: Self-referral or referral from any agency; referral form completed with the individual

hl-new-hope-sanctuary-watford.name: New Hope – Sanctuary Emergency Accommodation
hl-new-hope-sanctuary-watford.sign: New Hope site lists Sanctuary (up to 28 nights, £3/night); New Hope news Jun/Jul 2026 on Exchange Road
hl-new-hope-sanctuary-watford.access: Referral only: referrals taken through New Hope Haven only; Watford local connection

hl-dens-the-elms.name: DENS – The Elms hostel
hl-dens-the-elms.sign: DENS site (news Sep 2026): "Our 44-bed hostel ... provides emergency and short-term accommodation for single homeless adults"; Crash Pad / severe weather beds
hl-dens-the-elms.access: Referral only: via DENS day centre or agency referral; Dacorum local connection
hl-dens-the-elms.phone_note: DENS number on its outreach & accommodation page (page back up 23 Oct 2026); old 01442 262274 not on DENS site

hl-ymca-lincs-nomad-centre.name: YMCA Lincolnshire – Nomad Centre
hl-ymca-lincs-nomad-centre.sign: YMCA Lincolnshire "Our Tenancy Approach July 2026": "The Nomad Centre is the only direct access emergency accommodation in the area. Support is available 24/7"; Homeless Link listing gives address and admission
hl-ymca-lincs-nomad-centre.access: Self-referral or any agency; beds cannot be pre-booked; latest admission 8:30pm

hl-st-annes-hostel-birmingham.name: St Anne's Hostel
hl-st-annes-hostel-birmingham.sign: Homeless Link: "Direct access self-referral accommodation in the main hostel and open 24 hours a day 7 days a week"; corroborated by Spring Housing accommodation flyer (Jan 2026) listing St Anne's
hl-st-annes-hostel-birmingham.access: Direct access self-referral (main hostel), subject to interview; single men 25+

eh-nottingham-night-shelter.name: Emmanuel House Night Shelter (referrals via Emmanuel House Support Centre)
eh-nottingham-night-shelter.sign: Emmanuel House site: "short-term emergency accommodation for up to 20 people every night. 2026 is our 20th year of providing the Nottingham Night Shelter"; no opening hours stated
eh-nottingham-night-shelter.access: Referral only: members of the public contact Framework's Street Outreach Team (0800 066 5356); agencies call the Support Centre on 0115 950 7140. Age 18+. Pin is the Support Centre, not the shelter itself

orl-winter-night-shelter.name: One Roof Leicester Winter Night Shelter
orl-winter-night-shelter.sign: One Roof site: 'Every night from 5th October 2026 to 31st March 2027, up to 24 rough sleepers'; access via City or County Outreach
orl-winter-night-shelter.access: Referral only: through Leicester City or County Outreach. If you are sleeping rough, alert StreetLink (thestreetlink.org.uk) and outreach will visit. Pin is One Roof's office, not the shelter

robes-winter-night-shelter.name: Robes Winter Night Shelter (Southwark & Lambeth)
robes-winter-night-shelter.sign: Robes site: 'In order to access our Winter Shelter we require a referral from one of our partner day centres or the homeless outreach teams in Southwark and Lambeth'
robes-winter-night-shelter.access: Referral only: from a partner day centre or outreach team in Southwark and Lambeth (e.g. Manna Centre, Spires, Ace of Clubs, Webber Street, Crisis, The Passage, Southwark SPOT, Thames Reach Lambeth). Pin is Robes' office, not the shelter

glassdoor-winter-night-shelters.name: Glass Door Winter Night Shelters (3 circuits)
glassdoor-winter-night-shelters.sign: Glass Door runs three winter night shelter circuits; its Get help page says 'Our winter night shelters are now closed until late 2026'; 2026-27 dates 21 Nov 2026 – 22 Mar 2027 from Glass Door's own 2026-27 staff job pack
glassdoor-winter-night-shelters.access: Open access: register for a space through Glass Door (call or visit a partner day centre). Pin is Glass Door's office, not a shelter

hab-barnet-winter-night-shelter.name: Barnet Winter Night Shelter (Homeless Action in Barnet)
hab-barnet-winter-night-shelter.sign: HAB night shelter page: 'run a night shelter within the local community to house rough sleepers'; phone 020 8446 8400 on the page. Cycle one dates from St Mary-at-Finchley volunteer listing
hab-barnet-winter-night-shelter.access: Referral only: through Homeless Action in Barnet (HAB), 020 8446 8400

owns-oxford-winter-night-shelter.name: Oxford Winter Night Shelter (OWNS)
owns-oxford-winter-night-shelter.sign: OWNS site: 'OWNS supports the rough sleepers in Oxford each night during January through to March'; referral via St Mungo's, The Gatehouse, Crisis or The Porch
owns-oxford-winter-night-shelter.access: Referral only: through St Mungo's Outreach, The Gatehouse, The Porch or Crisis; must be rough sleeping. Arrive at the night's venue 9.30–10.30pm. Pin is the OWNS office, not the shelter
